hero.title: Cozy GL Food & Coffee
hero.subtitle: A perfect indoor itinerary for two foodies in General Luna.

items.note: Warm up with fresh croissants and flat whites at Spotted Pig Cafe.
Head to Kermit for authentic wood-fired pizza and fresh pasta.
Relax at Shaka with warm matcha lattes and indoor table games.
Enjoy a candlelit dinner with local-inspired dishes at Wild Restaurant.

costs.title: Estimated Food Budget for Two (sample prices)

note.title: Watch out for brownouts
note.body: Heavy rain sometimes brings brief power outages. Cafes with backup generators like Spotted Pig or Shaka are your best bet to stay dry and connected.
note.author: From a Siargao local
